review.summary: PR fixes the root cause (missing _release() call on PaymentError in place_order) with a focused, minimal change. New regression test exercises the exact reported scenario and validates both failure and success paths.

result.summary: Called self._release() in the except PaymentError handler of place_order() so reserved stock is restored on a declined payment. Added regression tests confirming stock returns to its pre-checkout level after a failed payment.
evidence: All 32 tests pass on m26-gen-1-fix-3, including two new tests in tests/test_issue_3.py: test_stock_restored_after_payment_failure (was failing before fix) and test_stock_decremented_after_successful_order (control).
